name: Ganache
source:
A bikini-armor clad warrior serving the kingdom of Zanji Zard.

A firm believer of the mantra that "Strength is power," Ganache looks down on technical skill in combat as second-rate. Because of this she often finds herself in conflict with Zena, a master swordsman, to the point that other party members have become fed up and refuse to engage with their arguments.

Prone to taking action without thinking it through, Ganache often causes many problems. However, she also often manages to solve those same problems with her sheer strength.
